results.title: Repetición
results.overview: Filmed between September and November 2015 in Península Valdés, in the Argentine Patagonia while living with a group of biologists who study southern right whales.  During these months the whales migrate to the peninsula to breed, some stranding onto the shores.

results.title: Vanished
results.overview: After Sita's disappearance at Mount Sarangan on Drupadi's 10th birthday, Tito's attitude became cold, leaving Drupadi sad. Her boyfriend, Raka, and her best friends, Maya, Ucok, Jamal, and Nurul, along with her parents' friends Bagus and Oji, and her uncle, Gancar, provided support for Drupadi. However, this was not enough, and on her 17th birthday, Drupadi set off for Mount Sarangan to search for her mother.

results.title: Kickflip

results.title: If These Walls Could Rock
results.overview: Rock stars, wild parties, and untold stories come alive at LA's iconic Sunset Marquis hotel, where music legends created unforgettable moments during the hedonistic peak of '70s and '80s rock culture.

results.title: Vir Das: Fool Volume

results.overview: Two best friends, Peued and Uncle, set out to remake the timeless love legend of Mae Nak Phra Khanong, but things quickly spiral out of control when the real Mae Nak shows up to play herself. On a mission to find her true love, now reincarnated as Krist, a rising young actor.

results.title: Happy Khush Ho Gaya

results.title: Conjuring Tapes
results.overview: While sorting through their late friend's belongings, two women discover VHS tapes showing them in haunting, unfamiliar scenes, each one drawing them into the grasp of a mysterious, malevolent entity.

results.title: From Orion With Love
results.overview: The story is about a shepherd named Akif who lost his young daughter Bahar 15 years ago. One day, while spending time with her near a cliff he believes she was abducted bv extraterrestrials. However, when he speaks about it, the villagers mock him, and even his wife refuses to believe him. After this incident, Akif dedicates his life to sciences like astronomy and physics. For years, he sends signals into the sky, trying to establish contact with aliens in the hope of bringing back his beloved daughter. Fifteen years later, just as he has completely lost hope, an unexpected visitor arrives at his home.

results.title: Retro Freaks II
results.overview: After inheriting the local toy stores, Cincy Nerd (Daniel Allen Day) and the Retro Freaks face a sinister new enemy who turns nostalgia into a nightmare. Now, they'll have to confront their past to survive the future.
